newsitem.title: USA: Amer. Home unit, 3-D Pharma in thrombin deal.
newsitem.headline: Amer. Home unit, 3-D Pharma in thrombin deal.

text.p: 3-Dimensional Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that it has a collaboration with the Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories Division of American Home Products Corp, potentially worth $64 million, for a first product.

3-D said that Wyeth will obtain worldwide rights to its orally active thrombin inhibitors currently in preclinical development, as well as any follow-on compounds discovered through the collaboration.
Thrombin is an enzyme that converts fibrinogen into fibrin, causing blood clotting.
For the first product developed and approved under the terms of the agreement, Wyeth would make payments of $64 million if all milestones are met for three drug indications.
These payments include an immediate cash and equity investment, research and development funding, and milestone payments.
Wyeth will make additional payments if a second product is approved under the terms of the agreement.
3-Dimensional will also receive royalties on sales of products developed through the collaboration.
Wyeth will be responsible for all development and licensing costs associated with the program.
